Name: Robin Sells Hardwood
Author: ManaketeSmoocher
Description:
I'm in the process of a challenge file where I do nothing but fish, which means... It's near impossible to get my hands on any hardwood for anything! I found myself wondering why Robin doesn't sell any, so I decided to try my hand at fixing it in a way I felt was balanced. Robin will sell hardwood for 1000g a piece, no discounted price for year one. [s]I'm currently trying to figure out how to limit the number of Hardwood she sells per day to 10, but for now it serves its purpose.[/s] Hardwood stock has now been limited to 10 per day!

[b]MOD(S) SHOWN:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal/]Diverse Stardew Valley (DSV) - Seasonal[/url]

[b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿
[*]Download Robin Sells Hardwood and unzip it to your mods folder!
[/list]
